## Faking It

A report that fails to disclose important information about inspection results is fraudulent. Unfortunately, that’s exactly what happened in New York City. In 2016, the city inspector general published “The Failure to Oversee Water Safety: The Delay and Misrepresentation of Water Quality Issues.” This report recounts how the city’s water board tried to conceal flawed safety test results following a “critical incident” in August 2013. On August 28, officials knew that a year and a half earlier, they had received a failed test on the city’s water. By August 30, the board had failed to disclose their knowledge in three critical communications. Two were public
